the "time-to-grow" cohort structure is the whole point of the model - x_t = (1-delta)x_{t-1} + g x_{t-3} - c_t at 73-75 and y_t = x_t + g x_{t-1} + g x_{t-2} at 83-85 describe a calf/yearling/adult pipeline with a three-year lag - and it is only ever written algebraically; a small flow diagram of the three cohorts would carry it. Separately, the important side note at 100 is typeset as bold **Remark** followed by running prose instead of a `{note}` admonition

**Remark** at line 100 uses bold as a paragraph label rather than to mark a defined term; nothing in the lecture is bolded at its point of definition (the breeding stock and total stock are introduced in plain text at 68-69)
